package com.x;
public class BValve extends BComponent {
  private boolean freezeTripped = false;
  private final boolean lockout = false;
  boolean valveInhibited() {
    return doorOpen || freezeTripped;
  }
  boolean compTrip() {
    return a.b || c || lockout;
  }
  boolean otherTrip() {
    return a || freezeTripped;
  }
  boolean notATrip() {
    return a || freezeTripped;
  }
  boolean plainInhibited() {
    return a || notPrivate;
  }
}
